shots.prompt: 视角：广角全景。李道玄背对镜头坐在电脑前，背影佝偻。房间里堆满了外卖盒和杂物，只有电脑屏幕发出冷蓝色的幽光。 重点：通过环境的混乱和冷色调，建立压抑孤独的基调。 [李道玄: young man, Li Daoxuan, glasses, messy hair, deep dark circles, sunken face, pale rough skin, exhausted expression, hunchbacked, sitting in dark room, blue monitor light glow, cinematic portrait, realistic style] [阴暗杂乱的出租屋: wide angle shot, dark messy room, silhouette of person at computer, glowing screen, piles of rubbish, claustrophobic, cold color palette, 4k, cinematic atmosphere]

shots.audio_prompt: Frontal close up, man removes glasses, hands rub tired eyes vigorously, heavy shadows on face, exhausted expression, slow movement.李道玄：微信又在狂闪，甲方那些“这版不行”、“重做”的消息像催命符一样，逼得人喘不过气。

shots.audio_prompt: Extreme close up, slow pan across dusty desk, cold light sweeps over calendar date marked with red circle, steam rising from leftover noodles. shots.dialogue: 李道玄：这种给甲方当孙子、吃泡面、熬大夜的日子，真特么够了，活得像具行尸走肉一样。

[电脑桌前: 电脑桌前, computer desk setup, glowing monitor screen, cold blue light, dark room background, cyber-noir vibe, messy workspace, anime style, high quality]

shots.prompt: 视角：高角度俯拍。一个没有任何标签的黑色快递箱被扔在地板中央。李道玄拿着裁纸刀的手入画，刀尖闪着寒光。 重点：悬念感，阴影浓重。 [李道玄: young man, Li Daoxuan, glasses, messy hair, deep dark circles, sunken face, pale rough skin, exhausted expression, hunchbacked, sitting in dark room, blue monitor light glow, cinematic portrait, realistic style] [出租屋地板: wooden floor, top-down view, messy floor, dark shadows, cinematic texture, realistic material]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：这时候送来的快递？我也没买东西啊，难道是谁良心发现送来的生日礼物？

shots.prompt: 视角：过肩镜头。箱盖被掀开的瞬间。不同于房间的冷光，箱内似乎并没有发光，但呈现出一种干燥的土黄色质感。 重点：现实冷色环境与箱内土黄色的色彩对撞。 [李道玄: young man, Li Daoxuan, glasses, messy hair, deep dark circles, sunken face, pale rough skin, exhausted expression, hunchbacked, sitting in dark room, blue monitor light glow, cinematic portrait, realistic style] [出租屋: messy rental room, cramped apartment, piles of trash, takeout boxes, clutter, dark atmosphere, cinematic lighting, loneliness, depression, realistic interior]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：让我看看是什么……造景箱？这土黄色的色调，看着怎么有一股扑面而来的干燥味？
shots.audio_prompt: Over the shoulder shot, hands lift cardboard box flaps, revealing dry yellow earth texture inside, contrast between cold room and warm earth tones.

shots.prompt: 视角：主观视点（POV），俯瞰箱内。极其逼真的黄土高原地貌，枯树、破败的茅草屋、干裂的河床。 重点：8K级细节，看起来不像模型，而像是卫星地图拍摄的真实地貌。 [无（箱内景观）: miniature landscape inside a box, Loess Plateau terrain, dry yellow earth, withered trees, ruined thatched huts, cracked riverbed, hyper-realistic, 8k resolution, satellite view texture, diorama style, no humans] [箱内微缩荒原: view inside a cardboard box, miniature world, dry yellow desert, ancient ruins, top-down perspective, tilt-shift effect, magical realism, highly detailed terrain]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：我去，这做工也太逼真了吧，这黄沙漫天的荒原，枯死的树木，简直就像是把一块真正的明末旱地给切下来装进去了。
shots.audio_prompt: Macro POV shot, slow aerial flyover of miniature loess plateau inside box, realistic terrain, dry riverbed, withered trees, 8k detail, satellite view style.

shots.prompt: 视角：低角度仰拍（箱内视角看人）。李道玄巨大的脸庞凑近箱口，眉头紧锁，眼神中充满了困惑和震惊。 重点：巨物感，李道玄的脸被室内顶光照亮，边缘有轻微畸变。 [李道玄: young man, Li Daoxuan, glasses, messy hair, deep dark circles, sunken face, pale rough skin, exhausted expression, hunchbacked, sitting in dark room, blue monitor light glow, cinematic portrait, realistic style] [出租屋: messy rental room, cramped apartment, piles of trash, takeout boxes, clutter, dark atmosphere, cinematic lighting, loneliness, depression, realistic interior]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：现在的模型工艺都卷成这样了吗？连空气里的热浪感都做出来了，到底是哪位大神送的？
shots.audio_prompt: Low angle looking up from inside box, giant human face looms over opening, expression shifts to shock and confusion, slight wide-angle lens distortion.

shots.prompt: 视角：移轴摄影效果（Tilt-shift）。画面大部分虚化，焦点正在寻找，模糊中能看到微小的黑点在黄土上移动。 重点：模拟人眼聚焦的过程，微缩摄影的景深感。 [高一叶: tiny girl, Gao Yiye, macro photography, tattered sackcloth, dirty face, scars on hands, black mud in fingernails, desperate expression, crying, screaming, ancient Chinese peasant look, hyper-detailed, realistic texture] [箱内荒原: barren wasteland, Loess plateau, dry cracked earth, dusty, yellow tones, macro scale environment, harsh sunlight, desolation]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：等等，那是……镜头好像没对上焦，那个在黄土上移动的小黑点是什么？
shots.audio_prompt: Tilt-shift photography, rack focus searching, blurry background slowly becoming sharp, revealing tiny black dots moving on yellow soil, depth of field.

shots.prompt: 视角：极度微距特写（Macro）。焦点清晰锁定在高一叶身上。她只有指甲盖大小，穿着破烂麻布，正跪在地上。 重点：极致的细节，连麻布的纹理和地上的尘埃都清晰可见。 [高一叶: tiny girl, Gao Yiye, macro photography, tattered sackcloth, dirty face, scars on hands, black mud in fingernails, desperate expression, crying, screaming, ancient Chinese peasant look, hyper-detailed, realistic texture] [箱内荒原: barren wasteland, Loess plateau, dry cracked earth, dusty, yellow tones, macro scale environment, harsh sunlight, desolation]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：天哪，真的是个小人！这也太精细了，只有指甲盖大小，居然连麻布衣服上的破洞和跪在地上的姿势都栩栩如生。
shots.audio_prompt: Extreme macro close up, focus locks sharply on tiny girl in rags kneeling, high detail of fabric texture and dust, cinematic lighting.

shots.prompt: 视角：侧面微距。高一叶用满是伤痕的小手，艰难地从干硬的土里刨出一截草根。 重点：动作的艰难，指缝里的黑泥，生存的残酷。 [高一叶: tiny girl, Gao Yiye, macro photography, tattered sackcloth, dirty face, scars on hands, black mud in fingernails, desperate expression, crying, screaming, ancient Chinese peasant look, hyper-detailed, realistic texture] [箱内荒原: barren wasteland, Loess plateau, dry cracked earth, dusty, yellow tones, macro scale environment, harsh sunlight, desolation]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：她在挖土？用那么细的木棍费力地刨出一截草根，还当宝贝一样塞进嘴里……这模型连饥饿的动作都能做得这么细？
shots.audio_prompt: Side macro view, dirty hands digging into hard dry soil, struggling to pull out a grass root, debris falling, realistic physics.

shots.prompt: 视角：正面微距。高一叶似乎感觉到了什么，抬头看天。在她漆黑的瞳孔中（或者旁边的水洼里），隐约倒映着李道玄巨大的眼睛。 重点：打破第四面墙的对视，宿命感。 [高一叶: tiny girl, Gao Yiye, macro photography, tattered sackcloth, dirty face, scars on hands, black mud in fingernails, desperate expression, crying, screaming, ancient Chinese peasant look, hyper-detailed, realistic texture] [箱内荒原: barren wasteland, Loess plateau, dry cracked earth, dusty, yellow tones, macro scale environment, harsh sunlight, desolation]

shots.prompt: 视角：中景。高一叶正要把草根递给躺在地上的母亲。背景处，几个模糊的黑影（山贼）突然骑马冲入画面，尘土飞扬。 重点：宁静被打破的瞬间，动态模糊。 [高一叶: tiny girl, Gao Yiye, macro photography, tattered sackcloth, dirty face, scars on hands, black mud in fingernails, desperate expression, crying, screaming, ancient Chinese peasant look, hyper-detailed, realistic texture] [母亲: middle-aged woman, ancient Chinese peasant, emaciated, tattered clothes, lying on ground, weak, dying, bloodstains, dirty face, tragic atmosphere, cinematic lighting] [荒原村庄: ruined village, ancient china setting, mud houses, yellow dust, dry landscape, chaotic, war-torn, motion blur, cinematic composition]
